style: dark technical/automotive brand system — near-black navy stage, bold uppercase tight-tracking sans, sky-blue + amber accent duo, faint blueprint-grid texture; confident, direct, no-nonsense inspection-report energy
font: system-ui heavy (-apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif) — no external font load

customize.note: No caption-* catalog block matches this exact two-line hook+punch+underline-hold structure with brand hex values (checked caption-kinetic-slam / caption-editorial-emphasis / caption-weight-shift — all are single-word or per-word transcript-driven karaoke styles, not a fixed two-line settle-then-land composition). Hand-authored per builder.md gap allowance, following motion-vocabulary primitives (slide_bottom/fade_in, scale_punch, underline_sweep) and the caption block conventions (flex-centered .scene-content, palette CSS vars, autoAlpha seek-safe reveal).

scenes.emotion: confident, direct — stating the problem plainly
scenes.motion: slide_bottom + fade_in, one-line settle (y:24px->0, opacity 0->1), power3.out, duration 0.5s starting at 0.05s

scenes.emotion: assertive resolve — the punchline that lands and holds
scenes.motion: scale_punch land (scale 0.7->1, y:16->0, opacity 0->1, back.out(1.6), duration 0.7s starting at 0.65s) in amber #ffb938 accent, heaviest/largest weight in the frame; underline_sweep accent draws beneath (scaleX 0->1, transformOrigin left, power2.out, duration 0.4s starting at 1.35s); holds fully static from 1.75s to 4.0s (2.25s held resolve, no motion in final ~1s+)
